title: Exclusive Time of Functions
description:
On a single-threaded CPU, we execute a program containing `n` functions. Each function has a unique ID between `0` and `n-1`. Functions are called **stack**wise where function B calls function A before B returns.

Given a list of `logs` in the format log which contains a function ID, the type of log (0: function start, 1: function end), and timestamp.

Return the exclusive time of each function.
